Results.ReviewText: Read the install setup as it applies to installing the axle braces/ wheels.There is a reason why they provide a third locking nut. Also if you do a lot of smoking use a good oven cleaner on the inside cover ,Spray it on , Rinse it off  cleans up very nicely and also cleans up the thermostat probe.Really like it ,enjoy going back to Charcoal  cooking.I now use my 12 inch cast-iron frypan more than ever, everything cooks well and the cleanup is easy.Charcoal baskets work extremely well. Have fun

Results.ReviewText: OK, I admit I had gotten lazy and owned only propane grills for the past 15 years. I finally decided to get back to real grilling, and made the choice to buy the Weber Original Kettle Premium. And boy, was it the right choice. There's a reason this grill has been around for so many years, and has millions of devoted fans all over the world. It's a well made piece of equipment that does what it's supposed to do, and does it flawlessly. I thought it would take me awhile to get back into the swing of cooking with charcoal, but this grill is so intuitive, straightforward and easy to use, I felt like I'd been using it for years. You can easily and quickly grill up some great burgers, a juicy steak, or use a 2 zone fire to slow cook whatever you like. A very versatile grill that will be my go-to outdoor cooker for a long long time. And Weber stands behind this product with a warranty and just about every part is available should you ever need them. Don't hesitate to buy this grill, you will not be sorry.
Results.Title: This Grill is Just Great!

Results.ReviewText: I always wanted a weber kettle grill.  I thought that they were too expensive.  I bought plenty of cheap grills over the years.  They might last a year or two.  Now that I have a weber, I have found that not only can I cook fantastic food in many ways, but I use much less charcoal that I did with other grills, which will end up saving me money in the long run.  The weber kettle grill has much better temperature control than others.  I can sear, smoke, or slow cook just about anything that I want.  I cook  three to four times per week on it.  I'm a happy weber owner and user.

Results.ReviewText: The Copper 22" Original Kettle Premium is my first Weber. I've been burning meat over fire for more than three decades, and after having this kettle for a few weeks, I realize a lot of good meat and money was sacrificed to inferior grills. I love the copper finish. It was a bit flashy for me and I would have bought black if the store had it in stock, but I'm glad they didn't.  The copper looks great during an Arizona sunset. The 22" is a perfect size for my family; typically just two but occasionally six people. Anything bigger would be a waste of space in the yard and on the grilling grate. I like the upgrades that come with the Premium. I'm not sure how accurate the thermometer is or exactly what it's measuring, but I love having it as it helps dial in the temperature. The enclosed ash catcher is great because even though I clean my grill the morning after, when the wind kicks up I don't have to worry about a mess all over the patio. I like the hinged grate, there's nothing wrong with it and being able to add fuel is super easy, but when it's grilling days are done, that'll be an upgrade. And speaking of upgrades, I love all the Weber accessories and after market goods that are available for the kettle. So I love this grill because of all those things, but it wouldn't be worth bragging about if the food coming off it isn't amazing. With the exception of one meal, everything has been fantastic. I made my first beer can chicken and it was so good I couldn't believe I made it. I also burned some quality Brisket burgers because I didn't manage my fire. That's probably the most important thing to learn about using these grills - fire and heat management. Take the time to learn the different techniques and how you can manipulate your kettle grill to suite your needs. If you can master that, with this kettle and all the accessories, you can make incredible meals you'll love and you'll love sharing. Now if you're convinced a Weber is right for you, don't be afraid of the price tag and don't get talked into buying something you don't need and won't use. Get the right grill for you, use it, love it. And download the Weber app as well as the BILT app for assembly - seriously, get the BILT app and you'll have the grill put together in no time.
Results.Title: Amazing grill - no more sacrificed meat

Results.ReviewText: Bought my son a 22" Kettle when he moved out.  He moved back in and I ended up using his grill, and became comfortable with it. Well as time went on, he moved back out and took his grill.  I missed the little convenient grill, so I went out and got the Premium. The temperature gauge, accessory holder and ash disposal container are great features.  I feel bad that I didn't pony up and get the premium for my son.  But financial issues at the time, were a factor.  If you're looking for a great quality, American Made excellent little grill its a must have.
Results.Title: Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22"

14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
